raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions step drops every POSTED transaction that arrives more than 26 hours after txn_ts. From batch 3 onward, each delivery carries about 25% genuine late-arriving transactions (unique txn_ids, txn_ts about 3 days before ingest), so they are silently lost from silver and every gold table. Removing the lateness cutoff, while keeping the POSTED filter, restores them; txn_ids are unique, so no dedup is needed.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
